DeterminationBasis: T16-001 requires the claim to name or unambiguously preserve its evaluated scope, evidence basis and applicable status, and fails where the claim materially exceeds what the evidence establishes. A material scope limitation whose omission would cause broader interpretation is therefore already captured by the existing bounded-claim control.

Existing T16 controls distinguish independent verification and self-assessment and preserve verifier identity and scope, but no existing control requires the verification record to identify the verifier's declared relationship to the originating party. A distinct relationship-disclosure control is therefore required.
